answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 56832 Country: India Title: Potency test Question: Can a Muslim take potency test before marriage? His semen will be checked whether he is capable of intercourse. Answer ID: 56832 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 90/91/N=02/1436) It is not lawful to discharge semen with the help of hand for the purpose mentioned in the question without a Shariah need. Hence it shall not be lawful to discharge semen for the purpose of test if there is no need as per the Shariah. If someone feels sexually weak before or after marriage, he should consult an expert and experienced Hakim or doctor for treatment. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
